problemSignature.failureMode: routing retries waste time when placement already blocks corridors

rootCause: FreeRouting and exact routing can stall when component placement creates narrow corridors or interleaved escape chains.
fixSummary: Add a placement repair loop that scores routeability, proposes corridor-opening moves, and selects better candidates before rerouting.

testsAdded: placement repair loop moves components away from blocked corridors

conditions: routeability score says repair placement before routing
